findings.transform_zero_point_mass: log_u/log_d encode exact zero extensions at log(1e-6)=-13.8155, creating a separated point mass rather than a continuous Gaussian-like target
findings.current_objective_gap: the current loss has a dedicated close-return term but no joint wick-span term; u and d are learned marginally in transformed units and receive negligible output-space gradient beside g/b
findings.candidate_interpretation: the proposed log(u+d) term couples upper/lower extensions without changing b, and uses only a fold's optimization-training labels for scale
limitations: Output gradients use a training-only constant marginal-quantile estimator, not the saved head's parameter gradients.
